Name: Nocturnal Sebastian - Immersive Schedule Edit
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]Everyone knows that Sebastian is the type of person who goes to bed at 3AM and wakes up at 10AM. Trying to find him is like finding Pelican Town's very own cryptid. And yet, in his vanilla schedule he starts heading home at 9:30 PM to be in bed asleep generally by 10:30 PM? On rainy days, he arrives back home and goes straight to bed at 7:40 PM? Who [i]is [/i]this?

This little mod gives Sebastian the sleep schedule we all know he has. If you somehow manage to get to his room at 6AM, you'll find him fast asleep until roughly 9:30 AM (varying slightly depending on the day). He'll sometimes get up immediately and sometimes lay around in bed for another hour, before getting into his regular schedule which is mostly unchanged. When night comes around though, instead of going to bed, Sebastian will just continue to use his computer until an unknown time because unlike the farmer, years of terrible sleep habits means that he doesn't pass out from exhaustion at 2 AM.

He'll generally wake up not long after Robin unlocks the main door, but it still might make it slightly harder to talk to him. To compensate for that, he'll stay in town a little longer on Saturday evenings and have a late lunch in the kitchen for a little longer on spring days.

Only affects his regular schedule, not his marriage schedule. Probably not compatible with anything else that changes his regular schedule.

Sebastian's outfits in the screenshots are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url].[/size]

Downloads.Description: The main file. To install, simply extract the "[CP] Nocturnal Sebastian" folder and drop it into your Mods folder.

Manifest.Name: Nocturnal Sebastian
Manifest.Description: Adjusts Sebastian's schedule so that he stays up late at night like we all know he does.
